data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'gossos', meaning 'pledged to God'. In ancient Greece, a 'gossos' was a sacred bond or pledge to a god. This name is a reminder of our commitment to God and our faith. The name Goss carries the meaning “God's pledge” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Goss usually hope their child will grow to embody god's pledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
